page_title: HEI 0-4 BAY | Heidenheim v Bayern Munich 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Bayern Munich keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
88' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
88' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Frans Kratzig will be replaced by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim).
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Raphael Guerreiro as he is replaced by Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich).
84' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
80' What was Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
79' Total attempts – 3:16.
76' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) sends the corner into the box, but Jonas Urbig intercepts it and averts the threat.
74' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Michael Olise and he is replaced by Gabriel Vidovic (Bayern Munich).
73' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
70' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Marvin Pieringer is replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sirlord Conteh walks off the pitch to be replaced by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim).

69' Bayern Munich hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
66' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

65' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Jonas Urbig is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
63' Here is a change. Kingsley Coman is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Kane leaves the pitch and Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) comes on.
62' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
61' Kevin Muller pulls off a great save to deny Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
59' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Kevin Muller pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
57' 0:8 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
56' 0 - 4 Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
55' The corner kick from Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
53' The linesman signals that Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
51' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
46' The game is over for Konrad Laimer. Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) comes on for the second half.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a switch. Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is coming on in place of Jan Schoppner at the start of the second period.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Niklas Dorsch. He is replaced by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
43' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
41' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) has tested the patience of referee Frank Willenborg and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
39' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
36' 0 - 3 Goal! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:3.
36' A snap shot by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Kevin Muller flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
35' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
35' That was close. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
33' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky!
33' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) will take a corner kick.
29' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Kevin Muller pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
28' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) commits a rough foul. Frank Willenborg stops the game and makes a call.
25' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
25' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

22' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.

19' 0 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Serge Gnabry, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich), who beats Kevin Muller with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 0:2.
18' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
17' 0:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
14' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Kevin Muller has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Michael Olise plays a short, square pass into the path of Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 0:1. Fabulous goal!
10' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
8' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
7' Flag up against Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
6' Some patient build-up play from Bayern Munich as they look to unlock the defence.
3' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Frank Willenborg.
